text:
alex_cheng: Pushed a quick benchmark summary from the overnight sweep. Strange throughput inversion on H100 at bsz=64 for seq=2048. Raw CSV and flamegraphs in the artifact link below.
perf-ci-bot: Automated run finished: h100/a100/l40s sweep (seq: 128/512/1024/2048; bsz: 1/8/32/64). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/3601234567/artifacts :white_check_mark:
mira_sato: Can you paste the exact command and config used? Was KV cache on for all runs?
alex_cheng: config used: `--kernel-policy=auto --kv-cache=on --batching=dynamic --max-batch-tokens=4096`

Command:```bash
./perf_runner --model redwood/7b --gpus H100 --seq-lens 128,512,1024,2048 --bsz 1,8,32,64 --passes 5 --kernel-policy auto --kv-cache on 
```
jonah_lee: Looking at the CSV, H100 throughput at seq=2048 bsz=64 drops ~28% vs bsz=32, while A100 keeps scaling. That smells like an allocator / memcpy contention or fallback to slower attention kernel.
tara_ng: Did the runtime switch from fused Flash->paged attention at that point? We recently changed the threshold for fusedpaged when seq*bsz > 131072. Maybe edge case.
alex_cheng: I extracted the kernel selector trace; here's the relevant lines:```
[selector] seq=2048 bsz=64 -> chosen: paged_fa_v2 (reason: smem_limit_exceeded)
[kernel] paged_fa_v2: avg_forward_ms=12.4 avg_backward_ms=0.0
[kernel] fused_fa_opt: avg_forward_ms=7.9 fallback_count=127
```
mira_sato: fallback_count=127 looks high. Is that per-batch fallback or per-timestep? Also, were prefetch windows enabled?
jonah_lee: Prefetch window was `prefetch_k=4`, default eviction=auto. If the paged kernel is being chosen because of a conservative sMem estimate, maybe the sMem estimator overcounts for H100 topology. We hit a similar thing last quarter with the L40S driver update.
tara_ng: Can you run a quick repro: disable paged variants and force fused_fa_opt on H100 for that config? If throughput stabilizes then selector logic is bugged.
alex_cheng: Running a targeted repro now with `--kernel-policy=fuse-prefer --kv-cache=on --prefetch-k=2`. Pasting perf summary when done.
perf-ci-bot: New artifact uploaded: https://ci.internal/runs/3601234567/repro-fuse-prefer/artifacts (logs + perf flamegraphs).
alex_cheng: Repro result: forcing fused_fa_opt recovers throughput to expected curve (bsz=64 now +30% vs paged). Quick flamegraph shows big memcpy hotspot in paged path (nvshmem copies + kernel syncs).
jonah_lee: That points to paged implementation doing extra host-device shuffles for some tiling pattern. Could be spill path triggered by our liveness estimate for KV cache combined with batch stride.
mira_sato: Try disabling KV cache for the same run to confirm interaction: `--kv-cache=off`. If fused still wins, KV cache + paged is the culprit.
tara_ng: Also run one H100 with `--mem-model=relaxed` (relaxes sMem budget) and see if selector switches back. If so, estimator thresholds need tuning.
alex_cheng: Run matrix scheduled: (1) force fused, (2) disable kv-cache, (3) mem-model relaxed. Will post numbers in a follow-up thread. For now creating a ticket: PERF-1278 "H100: paged_fa_v2 causes memcpy hotspot on high bsz/long seq" and assigning to eng-runtime.
jonah_lee: Add a note to the ticket to bisect kernel-selector commit range between d7f3b2..a2c4e9 (recent heuristic tweak). Also include perf traces.
perf-ci-bot: Ticket created: https://issues.internal/PERF-1278 assigned -> eng-runtime. Artifact links attached.
mira_sato: Great. One more ask: include a compact reproducer (docker + minimal model + command) in the ticket so infra can run on an H100 dev node.
alex_cheng: Will attach repro + minimal shell script. Plan: run nightly sweep with selector telemetry enabled and add regression alert if paged_fa is chosen > 10% for seq>=1024 & bsz>=32 on H100.
tara_ng: Sounds good. If confirmed, short-term fix = raise fused preference cutoff for H100; long-term = fix sMem estimator and remove workaround. :+1:
alex_cheng: Thanks all — I'll post numbers once the three repro variants finish (~2 hrs).
